title: Access Policies
subtitle: Define who may do what on which data as W3C ODRL policies. Audiences describe who, asset collections describe what; active policies are evaluated deterministically and compiled into reviewed releases for connected platforms.

list.audiencesHint: Audiences (ODRL PartyCollections) are reusable groups of principals: explicit users/groups, refined by attributes such as Ontos Business Roles. They are independent of Ontos Teams.
list.collectionsHint: Asset collections (ODRL AssetCollections) are reusable sets of data assets: explicit UC securables, refined by classification, tag or domain.
list.shaclHint: Download SHACL shapes that validate ODRL policies against the Ontos profile (any SHACL engine)

description.policy: An ODRL policy: permissions, prohibitions and obligations on assets for audiences or principals.
description.audience: An ODRL PartyCollection: listed principals, narrowed by the refinement (all must hold). With no principals listed, the refinement selects from all principals; with neither, the audience is empty.
description.asset_collection: An ODRL AssetCollection: listed assets (a catalog or schema covers its children), narrowed by the refinement.
description.target: Where compiled policies ship: a platform, the securables it manages, and how releases may be delivered.

form.personalDraft: Create as personal draft (only visible to me)
form.jsonHint: Rules in ODRL JSON: {"permission": [...], "prohibition": [...], "obligation": [...]}. Compact rules are expanded to atomic rules on save.
form.builderUnsupported: These rules use constructs the builder can't show (logical or inline collections). Keep editing them as JSON.
form.valid: Valid against ODRL 2.2 and the Ontos profile.
form.principalsHint: Pick groups and users from the directory (Entra ID) or type them; service principals as sp:<application id>. Leave all empty to select purely by the refinement.
form.assetsHint: One per line, e.g. uc:catalog.schema or uc:catalog.schema.table. A catalog or schema covers its children.
form.audienceRefinementHint: Members must also satisfy these conditions (e.g. Business role = Analyst).
form.assetRefinementHint: Assets must also satisfy these conditions (e.g. Classification = pii).
form.refinementUnsupported: This refinement uses logical constraints; it is kept as-is.
form.contentLocked: This version is {{status}} — rules and membership are locked. Send it back to draft (while under review) or create a new version to change them; name, ownership, domains and tags stay editable.
form.offerForHint: Every Agreement concluded for this product (approved access request) inherits this Offer's prohibitions and obligations. An Offer itself grants nobody access.

check.title: Check access
check.descriptionAll: Evaluate a request against all active policies and see exactly why it is allowed or denied.
check.descriptionPolicy: Evaluate a request against this policy (what-if, any status) or against all active policies.

import.title: Import ODRL policy (JSON-LD)
import.description: Paste a W3C ODRL 2.2 policy. It is imported as a new draft; its declared conflict strategy is kept (the spec default is 'invalid').

details.rulesHint: Atomic ODRL rules. Prohibitions vs. permissions are resolved by the conflict strategy.
details.audienceSemantics: A principal is a member if it is one of the listed principals (or any principal, if none are listed) and it satisfies the refinement. An audience with neither matches nobody.
details.collectionSemantics: An asset is a member if it is (below) one of the listed assets (or any asset, if none are listed) and it satisfies the refinement. A collection with neither matches nothing.
details.jsonldHint: The policy as a W3C ODRL 2.2 document (Ontos profile).
details.newVersionHint: Creates a draft copy of v{{version}}. The current version stays in effect until the new one is activated.
details.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}} v{{version}}? This cannot be undone.
details.personalDraftMessage: Only you (and admins) can see this personal draft until it is activated.
details.fromAccessGrant: Recorded from an approved Access Grant
details.offerFor: Terms of use (Offer) for data product

shacl.conforms: Conforms to the Ontos ODRL SHACL shapes.

releases.hint: A release compiles all active policies for a target into concrete grants, diffs them against the Grant Ledger and ships the change through the Delivery Modes after review.

modeHint.direct: Apply GRANT / REVOKE now via the Databricks SDK; the ledger updates per applied item.
modeHint.indirect: Write the release as Ontos YAML to the Git repository for your CI to apply.
modeHint.manual: Notify admins with a SQL runbook to run by hand.

releases.deliverDescription: Choose the Delivery Modes to use. Only modes enabled in Settings → Delivery are available.
releases.noModes: No Delivery Mode is enabled. Enable one in Settings → Delivery.
releases.confirmDescription: Confirm the release was applied on the target (e.g. the Git change was merged and run, or the SQL runbook was executed). The Grant Ledger is updated accordingly.
releases.awaitingConfirmation: Delivered via Indirect / Manual mode. Confirm once the change was applied on the target — until then the Grant Ledger is unchanged.
releases.liveMissing: Desired but not granted on the platform
releases.liveStale: Granted by Ontos but no longer desired
releases.description: Compiled desired state of all active Access Policies for this target.
releases.errorsBlock: Errors block review — fix the policies and recompile.
releases.changesHint: Diff against the Grant Ledger; {{unchanged}} grants unchanged. Grants Ontos didn't apply are never revoked.
releases.gatedHint: These permissions need a workflow (duties, purpose) or attribute-based enforcement and are never granted unconditionally.
releases.untrackHint: These grants already existed on the platform before Ontos applied them. Ontos stops tracking them and does not revoke them.

ledger.hint: Grants Ontos applied through releases and tracks — the basis for time-bound (GDPR) revocation. Grants created outside Ontos are not listed.
ledger.impliedTitle: Parent privilege (USE CATALOG / USE SCHEMA) required to reach the granted object
ledger.preexistingTitle: Already on the platform when Ontos applied it — Ontos never revokes it

duties.title: Duties
duties.openHint: {{count}} open — the access is granted once every duty is fulfilled.
duties.byGrantee: To be accepted by the grantee
duties.byAdmin: To be fulfilled by an Access Policies admin

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.notFound: Agreement not found, or you are not its party.

targets.hint: Targets decide where releases compile to. While no Unity Catalog target is active, the built-in 'uc' target covers all of Unity Catalog. Two active targets of one system may not overlap.
targets.keyHint: Stable identifier releases and the Grant Ledger use (e.g. uc, uc-prod). Fixed once the target has more than one version.
targets.scopeHint: Securable prefixes this target manages, one per line (catalog or catalog.schema). Empty = everything in the system. Narrowing the scope stops tracking grants outside it; they are never revoked.
targets.deliveryModesHint: None selected = any mode enabled in Settings.
targets.scheduleHint: Cron expression (Quartz or 5-field). Drift is reported, never auto-fixed.
targets.semantics: Releases for this target compile only the securables in its scope and ship through its allowed delivery modes.

drift.title: Drift
drift.hint: Report only: the Grant Ledger compared with the live grants. Nothing is granted or revoked. The hourly job checks each target when its reconcile schedule is due.
drift.unreadable: Live grants can't be read from this platform yet — no drift check.
drift.missing: Tracked by Ontos, not on the platform
drift.unmanaged: On the platform, not tracked by Ontos
drift.truncated: Only the first securables were checked.

issues.abac_outside_scope: {{rule}}: restriction on {{securables}} reaches beyond this target's scope ({{scope}})
issues.abac_unsupported_platform: {{rule}}: Snowflake targets can't enforce this restriction ({{kind}}) yet
issues.abac_unsupported_target: {{rule}}: ABAC policies apply to tables, not to a {{kind}} ({{name}})
issues.access_policy_error: The request could not be completed
issues.assignee_inexact: {{rule}}: {{reason}} — only the resolvable principals are granted
issues.audience_empty: An audience needs members or a refinement (an empty audience means everyone)
issues.builtin_orphaned: Grants tracked by the built-in '{{key}}' target would be orphaned — use the key '{{key}}' for the first Unity Catalog target to adopt them
issues.collection_empty: An asset collection needs members or a refinement
issues.column_mask: {{rule}} is enforced as a column mask
issues.column_mask_now: {{rule}} is enforced as a column mask (applied now — a mask can't wait for its start at {{at}})
issues.confirm_status: Only delivered releases can be confirmed as applied
issues.conflict_invalid_voids: conflict=invalid voids the whole policy if any permission and prohibition clash
issues.connection_user_names: user_names must map each principal to its Snowflake user NAME (text)
issues.connection_views: views must be a list of object names
issues.constraint_right_operand: Constraint needs exactly one of rightOperand / rightOperandReference
issues.cron_unsupported: '{{expr}}' is not a supported cron expression ({{reason}})
issues.delete_status: Only draft or retired versions can be deleted (this one is {{status}}).
issues.deliver_status: Only approved, delivered or failed releases can be delivered; this one is {{status}}
issues.direct_unsupported: {{system}} targets can't be delivered directly — use Indirect or Manual
issues.drift_policy_unsupported: Drift policy '{{policy}}' is not supported (report only)
issues.duty_admin_only: Only an Access Policies admin other than the Agreement's assignee can fulfil '{{action}}'
issues.duty_assignee_only: Only the Agreement's assignee can fulfil '{{action}}'
issues.duty_not_agreement: Duties are fulfilled on Agreements (a concrete party's deal)
issues.duty_not_on_permission: Only permissions may carry duties (use 'remedy' on prohibitions)
issues.expiring_outside_scope: {{count}} time-bound grant(s) are outside the target's scope; they stay tracked here until they expire and are revoked
issues.foreign_target: {{rule}}: {{target}} is not a Unity Catalog or Snowflake securable — skipped
issues.ledger_changed: The Grant Ledger changed since this release was compiled and the release would now ship unreviewed changes — send it back to draft and recompile
issues.live_grants_unreadable: Live grants can't be read from {{system}} yet
issues.logical_empty: Logical constraint '{{operator}}' needs at least one operand
issues.mask_overridden: {{rule}}: the policy's own permission overrides the mask (conflict=perm)
issues.modes_not_allowed: Delivery mode(s) not allowed for this target: {{modes}}
issues.modes_not_enabled: Delivery mode(s) not enabled in Settings: {{modes}}
issues.no_delivery_mode: No delivery mode is enabled in Settings → Delivery
issues.no_rules: A policy needs at least one permission, prohibition or obligation
issues.no_target: No active target compiles {{refs}} — configure an Access Target for that platform
issues.not_a_duty: '{{action}}' is not a duty of this Agreement
issues.not_editable: A {{status}} {{kind}} can't be edited — create a new version instead.
issues.not_ready_to_activate: Not ready to activate: {{count}} problem(s) — see Validation
issues.outside_scope: {{count}} entitlement(s) are outside this target's scope ({{scope}}) and ship with the target that covers them
issues.policy_conflict_invalid: {{policy}}: permission and prohibition conflict under the 'invalid' strategy — the policy is void and has no effect
issues.prohibition_inexact: {{rule}}: {{reason}}; a column mask must name its principals and securables
issues.prohibition_inexact_assignee: {{rule}}: assignee — {{reason}}; a prohibition must be exact to be enforced
issues.prohibition_inexact_target: {{rule}}: target — {{reason}}; a prohibition must be exact to be enforced
issues.prohibition_scheduled: {{rule}} takes effect at {{at}} — overlapping grants expire then
issues.prohibition_unconditional: {{rule}}: its constraints can't be enforced statically — applied unconditionally
issues.prohibition_unenforceable: {{rule}} only partly overlaps the grant {{principal}} {{action}} {{securable}} ({{overlap}}); the platform has no DENY — narrow the permission or the prohibition
issues.recompile_draft_only: Only draft policy releases can be recompiled
issues.refined_collection_uid: A refined collection must use 'source', not 'uid' (ODRL §2.5.5/§2.5.6)
issues.release_empty: Release has no changes to deliver
issues.release_has_errors: Release has compile errors — fix the policies and recompile
issues.release_number: Could not allocate a release number — please retry
issues.release_separation_of_duties: Separation of duties: the author or submitter can't approve this release
issues.release_transition: Cannot move a release from {{from}} to {{to}}
issues.rule_no_assignee: An Agreement needs an assignee on every rule
issues.rule_no_assigner: An {{type}} needs an assigner on every rule
issues.scope_entry_invalid: Scope entry '{{entry}}' is not a {{system}} securable name
issues.scope_overlap: Scope overlaps active or deprecated {{system}} target(s): {{targets}} — retire them first
issues.separation_of_duties: A version can't be approved by its author or submitter — ask another steward.
issues.snowflake_future_precedence: {{count}} database-level future grant(s) repeated on schemas with their own future grants (Snowflake applies only the schema-level ones there)
issues.snowflake_objects_as_tables: Snowflake objects are granted as tables; list views in the target's connection ('views') so they are granted ON VIEW
issues.subject_forbidden: Only the product's owners (owner team / project) or an admin can state its terms of use
issues.subject_incomplete: A policy subject needs a type ({{types}}) and an id
issues.subject_offer_only: Only an Offer can state the terms for an entity
issues.target_key_invalid: The key must be 2–40 lower-case letters, digits, '-' or '_', starting with a letter
issues.target_key_locked: The key of a target with several versions can't change
issues.target_key_taken: Another target (active or deprecated) already uses the key '{{key}}'
issues.target_tracks_grants: Target '{{key}}' still tracks {{count}} grant(s) — revoke them or release them from tracking first
issues.unknown_action: Unknown action '{{action}}' (not in the Ontos profile)
issues.unknown_left_operand: Unknown leftOperand '{{operand}}' (not in the Ontos profile)
issues.unknown_profile: Unrecognised ODRL profile '{{profile}}' — policy cannot be processed (ODRL §3.2)
issues.untracked_outside_scope: {{count}} tracked grant(s) are outside the target's scope and will no longer be tracked (they stay on the platform)
issues.used_by_active: Still used by active policies (deprecate or re-point them first): {{names}}
issues.version_exists: Version {{version}} already exists in this family

use.label: Use
use.description: Any usage of the asset (ODRL top-level action).

read.label: Read
read.description: Read/query the data (UC SELECT, READ VOLUME, EXECUTE).

modify.label: Modify
modify.description: Change the data (UC MODIFY, WRITE VOLUME).

ontos_browse.label: Browse
ontos_browse.description: See metadata without reading data (UC BROWSE).

distribute.label: Distribute
distribute.description: Share the data with third parties.

derive.label: Derive
derive.description: Create derived data from the asset.

aggregate.label: Aggregate
aggregate.description: Use the data only in aggregated form.

ontos_acknowledgeTerms.label: Acknowledge terms
ontos_acknowledgeTerms.description: Accept the asset's terms of use (workflow).

ontos_obtainApproval.label: Obtain approval
ontos_obtainApproval.description: Obtain an approval or authority decision (workflow).

ontos_recertify.label: Re-certify access
ontos_recertify.description: Periodically re-confirm the need for access (workflow).

delete.label: Delete
delete.description: Permanently remove all copies of the asset.

anonymize.label: Anonymize
anonymize.description: Anonymize all or part of the asset.

inform.label: Inform
inform.description: Inform a party about the use (notification).

dateTime.label: Date/time
dateTime.description: Point in time of use; compiles to grant expiry/activation.

elapsedTime.label: Elapsed time
elapsedTime.description: Duration of access; compiles to a time-bound grant.

purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.description: Declared purpose of use; attested via workflow, not technically enforced.

recipient.label: Recipient
recipient.description: Party receiving the result of the use.

spatial.label: Region
spatial.description: Geographic region of use; compiles to a row filter where supported.

ontos_classification.label: Classification
ontos_classification.description: Asset data classification; compiles to tag-based ABAC where supported.

ontos_tag.label: Tag
ontos_tag.description: Asset tag (namespace/key[=value]); compiles to tag-based ABAC where supported.

ontos_domain.label: Domain
ontos_domain.description: Ontos domain of the asset; materialized into concrete grants.

ontos_dataProduct.label: Data product
ontos_dataProduct.description: Data product the asset belongs to; materialized into concrete grants.

ontos_columnTag.label: Column tag
ontos_columnTag.description: Column-level tag; compiles to a column mask where supported.

ontos_rowCondition.label: Row condition
ontos_rowCondition.description: Row-level predicate; compiles to a row filter where supported.

ontos_businessRole.label: Business role
ontos_businessRole.description: Ontos Business Role of the principal (Audience refinement).

ontos_group.label: Group
ontos_group.description: Identity-provider group membership of the principal.

ontos_principalAttribute.label: Principal attribute
ontos_principalAttribute.description: Directory attribute of the principal (stub: future IdP/Lakebase sources).

ontos_remark.label: Remark
ontos_remark.description: Free-text condition shown to consumers; not enforced.

constraint.InConstraintComponent: {{path}} has a value outside the allowed list
constraint.NodeKindConstraintComponent: {{path}} has the wrong kind of value (IRI expected)
constraint.OrConstraintComponent: {{path}} matches none of the allowed shapes
constraint.XoneConstraintComponent: {{path}} must match exactly one of the allowed shapes
